cast_dialogue.linea: A hero also gets tired, heroes. When the body speaks, 'should' is the wise healer's word.
I've got a terrible headache. What should I do?
You should drink water and rest, dear. And you shouldn't look at screens.
I'm always tired. Should I go to bed earlier?
Yes! And you should drink less coffee, Ben. Five cups a day is too much!

banco_oraciones.oracion: We should go to bed early.
You shouldn't drink so much coffee.
Should we go for a walk?
Should I rest? Yes, you should.
Should he quit smoking? Yes, he should.
Should I take a pill? No, you shouldn't.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: 'Should' gives advice — it's softer than 'must'. It never changes form and the next verb is the base form: 'You should rest'. Negative: 'shouldn't'.

filas: I've got a cold. What should I do?

ejercicios.pregunta: I've got a toothache. You ___ see a dentist.

ejercicios.afirmacion: 'Should' is softer than 'must' — it's advice, not a rule.

ejercicios.texto: They ___ stay up late before an exam. (negative advice)

ejercicios.texto_con_error: She should to take a pill.

ejercicios.oracion_base: You should drink coffee at night.
ejercicios.respuesta: You shouldn't drink coffee at night.

ejercicios.pregunta: Your friend is always tired. Give two pieces of advice. (Use 'should' and 'shouldn't'.)
ejercicios.respuesta: You should go to bed early. You shouldn't drink so much coffee.

guion: Kenji: I've got a terrible headache, Carmen.
Abuela Carmen: Oh, dear. You should drink water and rest.
Kenji: Should I take a pill?
Abuela Carmen: Yes, you should. And you shouldn't look at your phone.
Abuela Carmen: You should go to bed early tonight. Sleep is the best medicine.

reading.texto: Ben is always tired. He drinks five cups of coffee a day and he goes to bed very late. His friends have some advice for him. Sofía says he should drink less coffee and he should go to bed earlier. Abuela Carmen says he should eat healthy food and exercise more. Kenji says he shouldn't work so hard, and he should relax on weekends. Ben should listen to his friends!

preguntas.afirmacion: Ben drinks five cups of coffee a day.
Sofía says he should drink more coffee.
Kenji says Ben should relax on weekends.

partes.parte: B — Une el problema con el consejo

ejercicios.texto: A toothache → (see a dentist / drink less water / run fast)
A headache → (watch more TV / rest and drink water / eat candy)
Stress → (work more / drink more coffee / relax and go for a walk)
Un amigo tiene un resfriado. Escríbele 3 consejos con should/shouldn't.
